correctness.rationale: For each properly colored cycle, the 3-neighbor strong-odd condition forces the leaf to equal the repeated pair of neighbor colors (one option), or if the two cycle neighbors differ, to avoid all three colors (k−3 options). The weighted cycle trace on directed color arcs counts ∑_proper (k−3)^d exactly. On k(k−1) arcs T f(a,b)=q∑_{c≠b} f(b,c)+(4−k)f(b,a); its constant eigenspace, 2(k−1)-dimensional standard block with characteristic X²+qX−(4−k)L, and symmetric/antisymmetric zero-row blocks of respective dimensions k(k−3)/2 and (k−1)(k−2)/2 exhaust the space. Their traces give displayed P_n(k) and annihilating recurrence, then polynomial identity extends from all k≥3 to 0,1,2. For odd n, at least three distance-two inequality defects are needed; cyclic signed-step count gives n(n²−1)/4 exact cubic leading coefficient at k=3. Evaluating transfer at k=2,3,4 gives χ_so=2 even, 4 odd and 3^n−3 four-colorings for odd n. Independently enumerated direct proper-cycle colorings for n=3..8 and k=3..5, matching formula; not an infinite proof.
residual_risks: The label convention is k distinguishable colors with unused allowed, not orbit counts up to color relabeling.
The k=3 polynomial zero order is in the indeterminate k, not a count of 3-colorings at k=3.

evidence: Caro et al. establish χ_so≤4 for a broad unicyclic class excluding a bare exceptional cycle; Kwon–Park define strong odd colors and generic bounds.
broader_coverage.reasoning: A bound on the minimum does not imply all k-coloring counts, recurrence roots/multiplicities, or sharp order-three vanishing at k=3. The exact even/odd sunlet scalar is a special refinement.

value.rationale: The all-palette coloring polynomial is a canonical exact enumerative invariant of sunlets, a natural infinite unicyclic family. Its constant-order length recurrence and order-three chromatic zero measure an exact obstruction beyond scalar chromatic bounds, and the parity-dependent optimal counts give concrete reusable benchmarks for strong-odd enumerations.
residual_risks: No general corona/unicyclic classification or other odd-coloring convention.

limitations: Only n≥3 one-pendant sunlets with labeled colors; finite checks are corroborative.
